limitations: Input latency is measured from browser keyboard dispatch until the next presented WebRTC video frame.
The metric does not include physical keyboard polling or display scanout.
The H.264 run only changes codec preference when the browser advertises H.264 receiver capability; the Neko default remains unchanged.
decision: Retain the pinned Neko default codec until a paired H.264 run and native WKWebView receipt show a supported improvement.
